extraction.notes: World laws 1-30 extracted individually; design claims remain UNVERIFIED.

claims.normalized_claim: Dirt, dust and soot act as visible memory of world contact and can affect tracking, slipperiness, protection or creature reactions.
claims.subject: world-law

claims.normalized_claim: Footprints are temporary material-dependent geometry that can be tracked and erased by weather.
claims.subject: world-law

claims.normalized_claim: Material fatigue should become visible before failure through cracks, fraying, discoloration or stress patterns.
claims.subject: world-law

claims.normalized_claim: Pressure, weight and load should be visible through compression, bending, sinking or stress coloration.
claims.subject: world-law

claims.normalized_claim: Wind should always have visible consequences on vegetation, smoke, rain, flames or clothing and also affect mechanics.
claims.subject: world-law

claims.normalized_claim: Smell is represented as a visible advected or diffused cloud that animals can follow and weather can alter.
claims.subject: world-law

claims.normalized_claim: Sound can be represented as visible waves such as puddle rings or echo highlights.
claims.subject: world-law

claims.normalized_claim: Moisture in masonry can create salt bloom and accelerate moss.
claims.subject: world-law

claims.normalized_claim: Rust progresses visibly from orange discoloration through dulling and holes toward collapse.
claims.subject: world-law

claims.normalized_claim: Oil, grease and resin can be visible state that is flammable, slippery and protective against rust.
claims.subject: world-law

claims.normalized_claim: Shadow can act as an ownership-like condition in which objects age differently.
claims.subject: world-law

claims.normalized_claim: Ground memory can encode familiarity or use through persistent color-temperature or surface change.
claims.subject: world-law

claims.normalized_claim: Fear and stress should appear as visual distortion rather than a status bar.
claims.subject: world-law

claims.normalized_claim: Disease, poison and infection should appear through visible body or image changes.
claims.subject: world-law

claims.normalized_claim: Plants should react visibly to light, heat, water and proximity.
claims.subject: world-law

claims.normalized_claim: Insects and small animals can act as environmental indicators such as flies near corpses or moths near light.
claims.subject: world-law

claims.normalized_claim: Blood should carry information through freshness, gloss, darkening and high visibility on some surfaces.
claims.subject: world-law

claims.normalized_claim: Magic can appear as a refraction or ordering error in pixels and light.
claims.subject: world-law

claims.normalized_claim: Time of day should change material behavior, including dew, drying and nocturnal growth.
claims.subject: world-law

claims.normalized_claim: Temperature gradients should be visible across materials, such as hot and cold sides of an object.
claims.subject: world-law

claims.normalized_claim: Cold should appear as progressive crystal growth, icing and fracture.
claims.subject: world-law

claims.normalized_claim: Water flow should expose topology through visible direction, depth and temperature.
claims.subject: world-law

claims.normalized_claim: Clothing should carry world state such as water absorption or material reflectance.
claims.subject: world-law

claims.normalized_claim: NPC mood can be communicated by local color temperature.
claims.subject: world-law

claims.normalized_claim: Ownership and prohibition can be represented as visible spatial order rather than UI labels.
claims.subject: world-law

claims.normalized_claim: Noise and light pollution should create visible environmental side effects.
claims.subject: world-law

claims.normalized_claim: Seasons should migrate gradually through shader and material state.
claims.subject: world-law

claims.normalized_claim: Hunger, thirst and exhaustion should be readable without a HUD through visible bodily or clothing cues.
claims.subject: world-law

claims.normalized_claim: Invisibility should remain an optical problem that rain, dust or shadow can reveal.
claims.subject: world-law

claims.normalized_claim: Repair should remain visible as a material intervention rather than resetting an object to pristine state.
claims.subject: world-law
